candidate: Aggregate ICE grades compress component and repeat-deficiency variation and may weaken or delay proportional contract consequences.

three_or_more_independent_contexts.reason: The grade/component divergence appears in 42 events across 13 facilities and five calendar years.

genuinely_surprising.reason: A compliant aggregate grade frequently coexists with separately reported component deficiencies, including repeat language.

descriptive_support.reason: The complete 78-event denominator supports the measurement distinction and preserves 29 explicit zero/no-finding controls plus four ambiguous component-status rows.

causal_mechanism_support.reason: No reviewed record links the aggregate grade itself to a deduction, CPARS treatment, option decision, extension, capacity action, or withheld remedy.

base_rate_control.reason: No comparable complete non-GEO ICE inspection denominator has been built; Torrance is a remedy comparator, not a grade-distribution base rate.

distinct_from_existing_hypothesis.reason: The proposed consequence mechanism is an upstream refinement of existing competition group geo-performance-consequence-gap, hypotheses #335 and #336.

falsifiable.reason: QASPs, discrepancy reports, UCAP closeout, invoices/deductions, releasable performance evaluations, and option/renewal decision records can test the chain.

actionable_without_duplicate_lead.reason: Human actions #38, #60, #61 and infrastructure request #150 already request the decisive records; a new lead would duplicate them.

decision.database_update: Twelve new ACH assessments were added for findings #12846-#12851.
decision.reason: The denominator result is a genuine, bounded systemic measurement finding, but the causal consequence mechanism is neither distinct nor sufficiently supported for a new hypothesis.

filtered_patterns.reason: Rejected as evidence-class error; 23 reports are timeline/medical summaries and the Gonzalez review explicitly disclaims deficiency-to-death causation.

filtered_patterns.pattern: Later funding proves oversight was ignored
filtered_patterns.reason: Rejected as chronology-only; public award descriptions do not disclose performance treatment or operational-need controls.

filtered_patterns.pattern: No public UCAP means no corrective action
